specialRules.name: Seven Deadly Sins
specialRules.summary: Before recruiting, dedicate the warband to Wrath, Envy, Lust, Pride, Sloth, Gluttony or Greed: in the builder, pick that sin's list. The standard list shows only the powers open to every warband.

specialRules.name: SIN MARKERS
specialRules.summary: Spell fuel, up to 6 on a model (a D6 beside it). Mortal Suffering: when a friendly DEMONIC model would place a BLOOD MARKER next to an enemy, place a SIN MARKER next to a friendly model instead. Perversion of God's Laws: when a friendly DEMONIC model would get a BLOOD MARKER, the opponent may instead remove one of its SIN MARKERS.

specialRules.name: Goetic Powers
specialRules.summary: ELITE models can have Goetic Powers (abilities and spells), as many as their entry says; each costs 1 Glory when learned in the Quartermaster Step. Spells are paid for in SIN MARKERS taken from friendly DEMONIC models anywhere (in sight or not); no Success Roll; the same spell at most once per Activation. A spell that needs a Cast Spell ACTION can be cast once per Activation each, as often as the model has ACTIONS.

abilities.name: Goetic Gaze ACTION
abilities.summary: Success Roll: on a Success place 1 BLOOD MARKER (2 on a Critical Success) on an enemy within 24" in Line of Sight.

abilities.name: Goetic Portal ACTION
abilities.summary: Risky Success Roll with +1 DICE: on a Success redeploy within 6", and may take an adjacent enemy on a base of 32 mm or less along.

models.note: A Mercenary, hired with Glory Points; its battlekit cannot be changed and it has no Faction special rules.

abilities.name: Slow
abilities.summary: Counts as Movement 3" when it takes a Dash ACTION.

abilities.name: Vengeful Scripture ACTION
abilities.summary: Success Roll against an enemy within 18" in Line of Sight (+2 DICE within 9", +1 DICE otherwise): an Injury Roll with +1 INJURY MODIFIER per BLOOD MARKER; a Critical Success adds IGNORE ARMOUR and +1 INJURY DICE.

models.note: A Mercenary, hired with Glory Points; its battlekit cannot be changed and it has no Faction special rules.

models.name: Sin Devourer

abilities.name: Devour the Guilty ACTION
abilities.summary: Picks a model within 1" on a base of 40 mm or less and, on a Success, devours it (it is held inside, counts as Down for Morale, and gains 1 BLOOD MARKER each Activation of the Sin Devourer until Out of Action at 6; a Purge ACTION releases it).

models.note: A Mercenary, hired with Glory Points; its battlekit cannot be changed and it has no Faction special rules.

abilities.summary: Free. Cast before its Injury Rolls: +1 INJURY DICE to all of them for that attack.

addModels.note: Always has Infernal Iron Armour; it cannot be removed and is in its Armour Characteristic. Goetic Powers: up to 2 Goetic Powers, one of them Blood Magic (free) (the count is not checked by the builder).

abilities.name: Annihilator
abilities.summary: One Fight ACTION per Melee Weapon each Activation.

abilities.name: Relentless
abilities.summary: Its Movement is not halved when it stands up at the start of an Activation.

abilities.name: Totemic
abilities.summary: When a friendly DEMONIC model Activates within 1" of it, place 1 SIN MARKER next to that model first.

abilities.name: Amass Wealth
abilities.summary: Enemies within 8" count the Weregild Threshold as half; place 1 BLESSING MARKER next to a friend with 3 or more markers that Activates within 8".

kitRules.note: Several arms: three 1-Handed Melee Weapons, or two and one 2-Handed.

abilities.name: Glory Lost
abilities.summary: +1 DICE to its Melee Attacks while there are 3 or more SIN MARKERS next to friendly Chain Fiends on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Greedy
abilities.summary: -1 DICE to its attacks while within 3" of another friendly model; its Melee Attacks have ARMOUR PIERCING against models worth the Weregild Value or more. Unless it wears a Restraining Muzzle.

kitRules.note: A Chain Fiend can have only 1 Ranged Weapon, costing 30 ducats or less (not checked by the builder).

specialRules.name: Miser's Audit
specialRules.summary: No Mortal Suffering. The warband has a Weregild Threshold (100 ducats on Turn 1, 80 on Turn 2, 60 on Turn 3, 40 from Turn 4). When a BLOOD MARKER would be placed on an enemy worth the Threshold or more by a friendly DEMONIC model that Activated, place 1 SIN MARKER next to that friend instead.

specialRules.name: Trade Network
specialRules.summary: Sell 1 piece of ducat-priced Battlekit at full price in each Quartermaster Step.

specialRules.name: The Prince of Greed
specialRules.summary: May choose the Counting-House as its Patron.

specialRules.name: Recruitment
specialRules.summary: Praetor, Sorcerer, Hell Knights and Chain Fiends must carry at least 50 ducats of Battlekit; up to 2 Goetic Warlocks, the first costing 100 ducats, as Court ELITE LIMITED POTENTIAL models (not checked by the builder).

kitGroups.name: Trench Dog training
kitGroups.note: one Special Training per Trench Dog (core rulebook p. 142)
